sloka: कौसल्यायाम् यथा युक्तो जनन्याम् वर्तते सदा ।तथैव वर्ततेऽस्मासु जन्मप्रभृति राघवः ॥२-२०-३॥
transliteration: kausalyāyām yathā yukto jananyām vartate sadā ।tathaiva vartate'smāsu janmaprabhṛti rāghavaḥ ॥2-20-3॥

translations.english: Rama conducted himself towards us in the same way as he did towards his mother Kausalya right from the begining.
